answer: Like a prism splitting one beam into many hues that still trace to a single source, collusion is detectable when identities share provenance. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchored to unique hardware attestation: each agent must lock tokens and prove a distinct physical root, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real capital plus scarce devices. An attacker flooding the ocean of agents finds each new island of identity demands fresh stake, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
